title: Only 21 Pentagon UFO Reports Stayed Unexplained
hook: Only 21 Pentagon UFO reports stayed unexplained.
closing: More reports improve scrutiny, but unexplained still does not mean extraterrestrial.
question: What would convince you?

segments.say: 757 new Pentagon UFO reports arrived, turning a fringe issue into a massive sorting job.
392 came from air traffic controllers, showing trained observers drive much of the surge.
Only 21 stayed unexplained, so mystery remains rare even inside a huge report pile.
